page.layout: One printed page of text, very faded. A title block of about three lines at the top, centred. Below it, a block of running text in the middle of the page, set in one column. No margin notes or footnotes can be read. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is legible.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and shows mostly show-through from the reverse side. The title lines at the top are barely visible, and the body lines in the middle cannot be read letter by letter, so they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The number of letters per line is an estimate from the line length. No marginal notes, page number or signature can be made out.
